mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN (T2.NODE_ID IN (#{BACK_OPERATOR}, #{BACK_CHECKER}) and ','||NEXT_USER||',' LIKE '%,'||'${userName}'||',%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END isTodo /*总集节点并且是当前审批用户时*/ FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T1 LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE T2 ON T1.SEQ_NO = T2.SEQ_NO WHERE TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and PROCESS_STATE != 'END' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE TT WHERE TT.SEQ_NO = T2.SEQ_NO AND TT.HIS_NO > T2.HIS_NO) AND ACTION_TYPE NOT IN ('delete', 'revoke')

SELECT min(RAM.AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT) AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT FROM RSK_AUTHORIZE_MNG RAM left join SYS_USER SU ON RAM.USER_NAME = SU.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT SD ON SU.DEPT_CODE = SD.DEPT_CODE WHERE (RAM.TRADE_DIRECTION IS NULL OR RAM.TRADE_DIRECTION = #{tradeDirection})
AND (RAM.ASSET_SEC_TYPE IS NULL OR RAM.ASSET_SEC_TYPE = #{assetSecType})
AND (RAM.TRADE_MARKET IS NULL OR RAM.TRADE_MARKET = #{tradeMarket})
AND SD.INSTITUTION_CODE in (#{institutionCode},#{institutionTopCode})
AND RAM.ASSET_TYPE = #{assetType} AND RAM.ROLE_POS = #{rolePos}

SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD A INNER JOIN STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PTL ON PTL.ACCT_NO = B.ACCT_NO AND ptl.ACCT_TYPE='A01' WHERE A.FINPROD_ID=#{chlId} AND PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}

select T1.ENTRUST_ID "entrustId", T1.PORTFOLIO_ID "portfolioId", T1.REMARK "remark", T1.ENTRUST_DATE "entrustDate", T1.VDATE "vdate", T1.MDATE "mdate", T1.CCY "ccy", T1.PS "ps", T1.PRICE "price", decode(T1.FINPROD_TYPE2,'F01', NVL(T1.ENTRUST_NUM, 0) - NVL(T6.DEALAMT, 0), NVL(T1.ENTRUST_AMT, 0) - NVL(T6.DEALAMT, 0)) "entrustAmt", T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 "finprodType2", T2.VDATE "dateStart", T2.MDATE "dateEnd", T2.TERM_DAYS "termDays", T3.FINPROD_ID "finprodId", T5.Type_9 "assetType1", T5.Type_10 "assetType10", T5.Type_11 "assetType11", T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID "finprodMarketId", T3.FINPROD_NAME "finprodName", T1.INV_MANAGER_ID "invManagerId", T4.TRADER "trader", T1.COUNTER_ID "counterId", T1.COUNTER_TRADER "counterTrader", T1.CONTACT_INFO "contactInfo", T1.CHL_ID "chlId", T2.IS_AGREEMENT_END "isAgreementEnd", T2.CREDIT_SOURCE "creditSource", T2.RATE_APPROVAL_CODE "rateApprovalCode" from ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T4 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T4.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( select SUM(decode(DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2,'F01', DEAL.SHARE_AMT, DEAL.PRIN_AMT)) AS DEALAMT, DEAL.ENTRUST_ID FROM ( select TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2,TPD.SHARE_AMT,TPD.PRIN_AMT,TPDA.ENTRUST_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID WHERE TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND TPDA.ENTRUST_ID IS NOT NULL union all select WTPD.FINPROD_TYPE2,WTPD.SHARE_AMT,WTPD.PRIN_AMT,WTPDA.ENTRUST_ID from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WTPD LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD WTPDA ON WTPD.TRADE_ID = WTPDA.TRADE_ID WHERE WTPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND WTPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND WTPDA.ENTRUST_ID IS NOT NULL AND WTPDA.WORKFLOW_STATUS ='01' AND WTPD.WORKFLOW_STATUS ='01' )DEAL GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID )T6 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T6.ENTRUST_ID WHERE T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

SELECT decode(T2.Type_8, '${fzq}',T1.ISSUER, '${fck}',T1.ISSUER, '${fxml}',T1.FINANCIER, T1.MANAGER) FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
